'''Nah Vee''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] criminal that was imprisoned on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. During the [[invasion of Belsavis]] around [[3641 BBY]] the Rattataki tribe of [[Blood of Talath]] broke free and began slaughtering prisoners of other species. After Nah Vee's fellow inmates were all killed, he managed to hide and hold long enough for a Republic individual to arrive and clear enough Rattataki for him to come out. In return, Nah Vee informed his savior of the [[Project Noble Focus]] and how much blood [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Tudos]] had on his hands.

==Behind the scenes==
Nah Vee is a non-player character in the [[2011]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' video game, appearing in the Republic Belsavis story chain quest, "Countdown to Jailbreak".

===Gameplay alternatives===
Republic players have the following two dialogues choices to deal with Nah Vee:
*Tell Nah Vee how to get to [[Minimum Security Section]], earning light side points.
*Abandon him to his fate, earning dark side points.
